meta.title: HAN Manifesto
meta.description: Hub for Agent Networks — principles for a shared language of commerce data for agents.
meta.demoDescription: Interactive mock of the HAN panel — scan marketplaces, review UCP issues, approve AI suggestions.

demo.title: Product analysis mock
demo.lede: Analyzes name, description, and photos — then proposes fixes. Each suggestion opens before/after side-by-side and needs its own approval.
demo.scanningHint: Checking images, titles, and descriptions against UCP / SEO rules…
demo.resultsLede: Open a product to review each suggestion in a popup — approve or reject one by one.
demo.queueLede: Only individually approved suggestions enter the queue — then apply in small rate-limited batches.
demo.queueEmpty: Nothing approved yet. Open a product popup and approve suggestions one by one.
demo.queueDone: Demo complete — each write logged; rollback snapshot kept.
demo.modalFooter: Approvals are per suggestion — nothing writes back until you send the queue.
